The '''Unifar Temple''', also known as the '''Onderon Palace''' or the '''Iziz Palace''', was the residence of the [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] from about the period of the [[Great Galactic War]] up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:UnifarTempleInterior-Onslaught.jpg|thumb|left|240px|The interior of the temple during the [[Third Galactic War]].]] The Unifar Temple was located in the center of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], close to [[Yolahn Square/Legends|Yolahn Square]]. Its throne room housed paintings of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] during his early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] as King of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].

==History==
The Unifar Temple was built sometime between the [[Dark Wars]] and the [[third Galactic War]], replacing the [[Iziz Royal Palace]].<ref name="Onslaught" /> During the Clone Wars, it was taken over by King [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] following the ouster of King Dendup. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Rash held the [[Death/Legends|execution]] of Dendup on the temple's steps facing Yolahn Square, but Dendup was rescued by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]] and the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]].

It was destroyed or demolished sometime prior to [[Operation Shadow Hand]], and replaced with a replica of the original palace.<ref name="Empire's End 2" />
